keeper.title: Keeper's Light
keeper.text: Saltreach Light burns every night now, kept by three stubborn people and one reformed ferryman.

fog.title: Fog Over Saltreach
fog.text: The lamp turns, but nobody on the island quite trusts you. The fog keeps its secrets.

cut_wick.name: Cut wick
cut_wick.text: The lamp's wick was snipped clean, not burned down.

shears_oil.name: Oily shears
shears_oil.text: Boathouse shears with fresh lamp oil on the blades.

wet_prints.name: Big wet boot prints
wet_prints.text: Fresh prints from the slipway to the toolbox. Large boots.

ledger_gap.name: Ledger gap
ledger_gap.text: No ferry crossing logged at midnight, yet three hours of fuel are gone.

lantern_boat.name: Lantern on the water
lantern_boat.text: Juniper saw a single lantern rowing toward the island at midnight.

ott_alibi.name: Ott's alibi
ott_alibi.text: Ott says he was asleep by ten and never left his cottage.

combine.text: You soak the new wick in oil. It'll take a flame now.
